# Nau-ino

> Security, access control and analytics for any site, on the CCTV cameras it already has, at a low energy cost. A student project: face check of people on existing cameras, night alerts for schools, worker analytics and a local face search. Figures marked as estimates or targets on the site are assumptions, not results.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/): problem, product, proof (distance and mask tests), technology, team, business model.
- [For schools](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/landing/): customer landing page; flags strangers on a school's own cameras at night, free 30-day pilot.
- [Pitch](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/pitch/): problem, product, proof, customer validation, market, business model, competition, team and the ask.
- [M2 Validation 1](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/M2/): customer discovery, problem first, then the solution.
- [M3 Wireframe and landing page](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/M3/): clickable wireframe of the school console, screen map and app demos.
- [M4 UX](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/M4/): interviews, personas, user stories, use cases and user flows.
- [M5 Lead generation](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/M5/): lead forms, PostHog analytics, the campaign posts per channel and the channel comparison.
- [User manuals](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/manuals/): PDF manuals in English and Romanian for the camera app, Worker Analytics, the Android app and the 3D face demo.
- [3D Face demo](https://alexx1612.github.io/faceprofiler-fiki/face3d/): a face photo turned into a textured 3D mesh in the browser (stock faces only).
